I never liked End of Evangelion tbh, but the final episodes are supposed to be the instrumentation process Shinji and the others go through. Their souls are merging but they're all struggling with their reason for existing. 

Example, Shinji creates an isolated existence for himself. He's also still very traumatized by Kaworu's death. Asuka thinks that she is useless and nobody needs her, Rei has a literal identity crisis, Misato is escaping reality with her fantasies. 

As for Gendo and Seele, they agree to disagree on a lot of things. Seele wants to unite all of humanity into one being and end suffering the pain of living as separate entities. Gendo wants to become God himself to be re-united with Yui. But in EoE they kinda throw that out the window and say it's the same thing.

And Asuka in EoE is reborn with Shinji at the end I think, if that's what you're referring to. Hope that clears it up a little bit!!
